boundaries.disposition: SAFETY_DISCHARGED: src/runtime/bio/bf_readbuff.rs:231 — readbuffer_write has an empty precondition set. The body ignores _b, _in and _inl, dereferences nothing, touches no global or thread state, contains no unsafe block, call or allocation, and returns the constant 0. Therefore every argument value (NULL, dangling, unaligned, arbitrary _inl) yields 0 without UB. Its only writer is READBUFFER_METHOD.bwrite_old at :48; neither an export nor any other writer exists. The 3.6.4 authority's readbuffer_write is also `{ return 0; }`.
boundaries.contract: The C ABI operation is `int (BIO *, const char *, int)`. Because the body is the constant `0`, the callee derives no Rust reference, reads and writes no pointee, and has no failure path. `bwrite_conv` copies `legacy_write` out of the live method table before calling it and passes the raw arguments; no property of `_b`, `_in` or `_inl` is needed for this body to be UB-free.
established: The full body is exactly `{\n    0\n}`: one integer literal and no other expression (src/runtime/bio/bf_readbuff.rs:231-233).
The parameters are named `_b`, `_in`, `_inl`; Rust's unused-parameter convention confirms the body does not bind or read them.
The body contains no unsafe block, no dereference, no function call, no static/thread-local access and no allocation.
